claim: Ukraine's Euro-Atlantic security relationship is linked to concrete U.S. security-assistance channels observable in 2021.
The same security alignment is linked to a second 2021 USAI assistance package supporting command, control and situational awareness.
The 2021 security relationship also produced a direct drawdown package including Javelin systems, small arms and ammunition.

Energy interdependence is linked to a large commercial EU-to-Russia energy revenue channel in 2021; the exact EUR 99bn figure is retrospective and therefore not admissible before its 2022 publication without contemporaneous reconstruction.
The contested European security order included sanctions regimes that constrained selected Russian actors and economic channels before the 2022 full-scale invasion.

Russia's large oil-and-gas export system is part of the structural energy interdependence background, but later IEA totals are retrospective and not valid pre-cutoff evidence unless reconstructed from contemporaneous data.
